findings.source: TokenPool.sol:686-689 s_remoteChainConfigs[selector].remotePools.values() / .remove(remotePools[j]) (EnumerableSet.Bytes32Set inside a mapping of structs)
findings.issue: The set's array (struct member at slot +5) and index mapping (+6) inside the mapping element are printed as raw nested sha3 slots (41 lines), while the length is shown as stor8[k].field_1280.
findings.rule: sha3(sha3(k, m) + c) + i is element i of the dynamic array at member offset c of mapping m's element k, and sha3(v, sha3(k, m) + c) is key v of the mapping at that member: print them as stor8[k].<member c>[i] / [v].
